description.full:
Reconcile accounts, prepare journal entries, analyze variances, and report results.

Helps company accounting professionals complete common tasks more efficiently and with greater confidence. Streamline workflows such as adhoc journal entries, reconciliations, reporting & forecasting, tax preparation, and month-end activities. Ask questions in natural language, receive guided assistance for accounting workflows, and reduce repetitive tasks while retaining control over decisions, outputs, and final review.

Important note: Responses are generated by AI and may contain mistakes. Skills are optimized for ENUS. Microsoft 365 Copilot does not replace qualified accounting judgment.  You are solely responsible for verifying any output before acting on it.

Sign up: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/pricing/enterprise

Get started: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/get-started-with-cowork

Help: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/cowork/use-cowork

Contact us: https://support.microsoft.com/home/contact
